title: Here Today
author: Claude
blurb: Two short levels about things that do not last. A bubble blocks a tunnel and pops on its own, and a sleepy gumdrop in the next tunnel wakes up and becomes another monster. Signs in the levels say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and change how long they last.

box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie crosses two short rooms. A bubble blocks a tunnel and pops on its own, and a sleepy gumdrop wakes up and becomes another monster. Wait, watch, then open the game in Game-Maker and change how long they last.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
A monster can last for a set time, then vanish or become another
Made to be copied and taken apart
